issues.title: Past-due invoices labeled Active
issues.detail: Two monthly invoices whose due date has passed show the Active badge, while the Status filter defines Active as 'Unpaid and not overdue' and every other past-due invoice shows Overdue. The summary card counts 3 overdue, so these two are missing from it.
issues.evidence: List rows: 'Aug 31 · 24 days ago · Active · Meridian Consulting · $2,000.00 · INV-0025' and 'Aug 31 · 24 days ago · Active · Nebula Strategy Group · $7,500.00 · INV-0018'; filter option text 'Active — Unpaid and not overdue'; Overdue card '3 Invoices'.

issues.title: Invoice numbers mix zero-padded and unpadded formats
issues.detail: Seeded invoices use a 4-digit zero-padded number (INV-0033), invoices created in the product get INV-34, a new series previews INV-1, and editing a series switches the prefix to the series ID (S-0003-4). The formats end up side by side in the same table and break sort order.
issues.evidence: Invoice list cells 'INV-0007', 'INV-0013'; Invoice details 'Invoice number' input value 'INV-34'; series detail queued row 'INV-34' above 'INV-0025'; Recurring series set up preview 'Invoice no. INV-1'; Edit recurring series 'Invoice prefix' value 'S-0003', preview 'Invoice no. S-0003-4'.

issues.title: Same invoice number and payment link reused across different requests
issues.detail: INV-34 was assigned to three different documents in one session, and the payment-link slug for the one-time invoice was reused for a later standalone payment link to a different customer.
issues.evidence: New one-time invoice to Orbital: Invoice number input 'INV-34', success link https://demo.mercury.com/pay/ylk7fnl18bpkfcg9. Meridian series queued row: 'INV-34'. Astral series queued row: 'INV-34'. Vega payment link success: 'https://demo.mercury.com/pay/ylk7fnl18bpkfcg9'.

issues.title: Five different date formats for the same kind of value
issues.detail: Dates appear as 'Sep 24' (tables), 'Sep 24, 2026' (form inputs, reminder schedule, panels), '09/24/2026' (invoice preview terms), 'SEP 24 - CREATED BY' (uppercase activity timeline), and 'Mar 31, 2026' in filter range inputs. The invoice preview is the only place using numeric MM/DD/YYYY.
issues.evidence: Invoice list cell 'Sep 24'; Invoice date input value 'Sep 24, 2026'; preview Terms 'Invoice date 09/24/2026 / Due date 10/24/2026'; detail timeline 'SEP 24 - CREATED BY JANE B.'; customer panel 'Sep 2, 2026' vs customer table 'Sep 2'.

issues.title: Currency cents rendered two ways
issues.detail: Tables, totals and detail panels render cents as a smaller raised fraction ($16,500.00 with 10.95px cents on 15px), while confirmation screens, invoice previews, the catalog item panel and review summaries render flat '$7,500.00' at one size.
issues.evidence: List amount: whole 15px, fractional span ._fractionalDelimiter_ parent 10.95px. Success screen '$7,500.00' at 34px: innerHTML '$7,500.00' with no size change on the fraction. Catalog panel '$1,250.00' plain text.

issues.title: Unit price inputs format differently depending on source
issues.detail: A price picked from the catalog shows two decimals, a typed or prefilled price shows none, so two rows of the same line-item table disagree.
issues.evidence: Invoice set up: row 1 (catalog Advisory Retainer) input value '5,000.00', row 2 (typed) '1,250'. Edit Invoice (catalog-prefilled rows): '12,000' and '4,500'.

issues.title: Primary buttons look disabled but are clickable
issues.detail: Next renders at 40% opacity until the form is valid, but it is not disabled and clicking it runs validation. Add customer and Add Item use real disabled buttons for the same situation, so the dim style means two different things.
issues.evidence: Request money Next before a customer: opacity 0.4, disabled=false, cursor pointer, bg rgb(82,102,235), padding 8px 28px 8px 32px, 40px; clicking shows 'Please complete this field'. Add Item 'Create item' and Add customer 'Create customer': disabled attribute set.

issues.title: Back button styled two ways within the same flows
issues.detail: The Back button is a filled secondary pill on setup/details steps and on the series review step, but a transparent text button on the one-time invoice review step and the payment link step.
issues.evidence: Invoice set up and Invoice details Back: class _secondary_, bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), padding 8px 32px 8px 28px, 40px. Review and send Back: class _tertiary_, bg rgba(0,0,0,0), same padding and height. Series Review and create Back: bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12).

issues.title: Payment methods named inconsistently
issues.detail: The same payment methods are spelled differently across the builder, the payer page and the invoice PDF preview, often on the same screen.
issues.evidence: Invoice details Methods summary: 'Manual Transfer (ACH/Wire), Pay with Mercury, International wires'. Payer page preview headings: 'Manual Transfer', 'International Wire', 'Pay With Mercury'. Invoice preview Pay via: 'Manual transfer, Pay by Mercury' (plus 'ACH Debit' on Edit Invoice).

issues.title: Title Case headings and buttons among sentence case
issues.detail: Most headings and actions use sentence case, but several use Title Case for no reason.
issues.evidence: Title Case: 'Edit Invoice' (vs 'Edit recurring series' and 'Invoice set up'), 'Add Item' (vs 'Add customer' and the 'Add item' button that opens it), 'Yes, Send Now', 'Cancel Invoice', 'Set Up' (vs 'Set up Stripe integration'), 'Manage Logo', 'View All' (next to 'View'), 'Download Invoice' (vs 'Pay invoice'), Transaction match column 'Payment Method' next to 'Paid on' / 'Paid by'.

issues.title: Status badges reuse or drop color inconsistently
issues.detail: Active and Processing use the identical 'pearl' badge, so two different states look the same. Overdue and Paid use tinted text, while Active, Processing and Scheduled use neutral text on tinted fills. Series use 'Completed' while the invoice list labels the same series 'Series complete'.
issues.evidence: Active: bg rgba(141,164,245,0.2), text rgb(221,221,229), class _pearl_. Processing: bg rgba(141,164,245,0.2), text rgb(221,221,229), class _pearl_. Overdue: bg rgba(252,155,111,0.2), text rgb(252,155,111). Paid: bg rgba(119,197,153,0.2), text rgb(119,197,153). Scheduled: bg rgba(119,190,207,0.2), text rgb(221,221,229).

issues.title: Empty values shown with different placeholders
issues.detail: The invoice list uses an em dash for missing values, the Customers and Catalog panels use a hyphen, and the customer panel spells it out.
issues.evidence: Invoice list payment-link row due date '—' (U+2014, charCode 8212). Customers 'Last paid you' '-' (U+002D, charCode 45). Catalog panel 'Used -'. Customer panel 'Last paid you: No payment history'.

issues.title: Customers and Catalog tables overhang the page header
issues.detail: The Customers and Catalog tables extend 18px past the right edge of the header action button; the invoice list table aligns with it.
issues.evidence: Customers: table right 1332px, 'Add customer' right 1314px. Catalog: table right 1332px, 'Add item' right 1314px. Invoicing: table right 1314px. Row heights also differ: invoices 66px, customers/catalog 51px, series 97px.

issues.title: Detail panels style Edit/Delete differently
issues.detail: The customer panel shows Edit and Request as neutral pills with icons and Delete as a red-tinted pill; the catalog item panel shows Edit as a full-width primary blue button and Delete as a neutral pill, both without icons.
issues.evidence: Customer panel: Edit bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12) + svg, Request same, Delete bg rgba(252,146,180,0.2) color rgb(252,146,180) + svg; all 32px. Catalog panel: Edit bg rgb(82,102,235) class _primary_, 147px wide, no svg; Delete bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12) class _secondary_, no svg.

issues.title: Series Frequency step uses off-system controls
issues.detail: The Frequency step uses inline mad-libs dropdowns with a solid FontAwesome caret and a compact 32px date field with 4px corners, while every other form uses 40px fields with 8px corners and outline chevrons.
issues.evidence: Frequency dropdown button: bg transparent, 13.33px, icon svg 'fa-caret-down' (data-prefix fas). 'Send your first invoice' date field: height 32px, radius 4px, font 15px. Add customer inputs: height 40px, radius 8px; Additional emails combobox 42px.

issues.title: Filter popovers are fixed-height with large empty areas
issues.detail: The Type filter popover is a fixed 400px tall with three checkboxes (144px of content), leaving about 250px of empty panel over the table. The Status popover also has trailing empty space.
issues.evidence: Type popover: ._menu_ height 400px, width 376px, bg rgb(39,39,53), radius 12px; ._popoverContent_ height 144px.

issues.title: Filter labels don't match column names
issues.detail: The Filters panel and Type menu name fields and values differently from the table columns they filter.
issues.evidence: Filter facets 'Due Date', 'Invoice Number', 'Invoice Date' vs columns 'Due date', 'Invoice no.', 'Invoice date'. Type menu 'One time invoice' / 'Recurring invoice' vs column values 'One time' / 'Monthly' / 'Quarterly'.

issues.title: Company shown under two different names
issues.detail: The sidebar and full-screen forms identify the business as 'Mercury Demo', but every invoice, email and payer page says it comes from 'Nebula Consulting Group', which is also easy to confuse with customer 'Nebula Strategy Group'.
issues.evidence: Sidebar org switcher 'Mercury Demo'; Add customer header 'Mercury Demo'; email preview 'From: Mercury on behalf of Nebula Consulting Group'; settings Company name 'Nebula Consulting Group'.

issues.title: Switches placed on opposite sides of their labels
issues.detail: In Invoice settings, the Address and Phone number switches sit at the right end of their rows, while the Configurations switches on the same tab and the Defaults switches sit left of their labels.
issues.evidence: General tab role=switch left positions: 560, 560, 120, 120, 120 (x in px). Defaults tab: 120, 120. All 40px wide.

issues.title: Escape silently discards the invoice draft
issues.detail: Inside the full-screen Request money and Create series flows, one Escape keypress exits to the list and throws away everything entered, with no confirmation, even when Escape was meant to close an open dropdown. The same happens on the full-screen series page.
issues.evidence: On the series Frequency step with the payment-terms menu open, a single Escape navigated to /invoicing/series and discarded customer, line item and Net 30. On /invoicing/create-invoice step 1, Escape navigated to /invoicing. On /invoicing/series/srs-meridian-monthly Escape returned to /invoicing/series.

issues.title: Icon-only controls without accessible names
issues.detail: The per-row edit and request buttons in Customers have no text, aria-label or title, and the branding color swatches are announced by internal ids.
issues.evidence: Customers row buttons: aria-label null, title '', textContent '' (class _button_ _small_ _tertiary_). Branding radios exposed as 'white-theme', 'green-theme', 'blue-theme', 'beige-theme', 'orange-theme', 'purple-theme'; the 'white-theme' swatch is dark grey.

issues.title: Series list, detail and invoices disagree
issues.detail: The same series shows different next dates and amounts depending on where you look, and a new series claims an email went out that its activity doesn't show.
issues.evidence: Meridian: list 'Next on Oct 1', detail 'Next on Oct 24, 2026'. Solstice S-0005: list $1,200.00, invoices INV-0031/0032 'Monthly · Series canceled' $2,000.00. Astral success: 'We've emailed the first invoice…', detail activity only 'Oct 24 · Queued · INV-34'. Detail 'Updated by Grace Hopper' vs timeline 'CREATED BY JANE B.'.

issues.title: Email preview shows broken sentences before a due date exists
issues.detail: On the setup step the email preview interpolates an empty due date into its copy.
issues.evidence: Preview Text: 'Please review and pay your invoice by' (ends there). Body: 'Nebula Consulting Group has sent you an invoice #INV-34 due on for $8,165.63.'

issues.title: Dismiss labels, toasts and confirmations use mixed wording
issues.detail: Dialogs dismiss with 'Close' in some places and 'Go back' in others. The catalog calls the same thing 'Item' and 'Product'. Send actions mix '&' and 'and', and success headings mix punctuation.
issues.evidence: 'Close' in Mark as paid, Send a reminder, Skip queued invoice, Cancel invoice; 'Go back' in Delete customer, Delete item, Add Item. Toasts 'Item added' vs 'Product deleted', 'Item canceled' for an invoice, 'Invoice created and sent!'. Buttons 'Create & send email' vs 'Create series and send'. Headings 'Your invoice has been created and sent!' vs 'Your recurring series has been created'.

issues.title: Series stat row mixes value sizes
issues.detail: On the series detail header, the Amount value is smaller than its sibling Series ID and Primary email values.
issues.evidence: Amount value 15px/400, line-height 24px; Series ID 17px/400, 28px; Primary email 17px/400, 28px.

issues.title: Settings close button overlaps the preview card
issues.detail: In Invoice settings the page close X sits on top of the invoice preview card's top-right corner.

issues.title: New catalog item shows a past 'Last updated' date
issues.detail: An item created today (Sep 24, 2026) shows 'Last updated Sep 19, 2026' in its panel, the same date as every seeded item.
issues.evidence: Catalog panel for newly created 'Onboarding Workshop': 'Last updated Sep 19, 2026'; demo date Sep 24, 2026; 'Used -', 'Last used: Item has not been used yet'.

issues.title: Canceled invoice vanishes and totals don't change
issues.detail: After cancelling an invoice from the bulk bar, the row disappears even with Show canceled switched on, and the Total open card keeps counting it, although its own tooltip says open excludes canceled items.
issues.evidence: Before: Total open '$86.3K · 12 Invoices · 1 Payment link', row 'Oct 24 · Scheduled · Quasar Design Studio · $12,000.00 · INV-0014'. After 'Cancel Invoice' and 'Item canceled' toast at /invoicing?showCanceled=true: no row matches INV-0014, card text still '$86.3K Total open 12 Invoices 1 Payment link'. Tooltip: 'Open includes all items that are not paid or canceled.'

issues.title: 'Invoice not found' error after creating an invoice
issues.detail: Return to dashboard after sending a new invoice lands on the list with the new invoice id, and an error toast says the invoice doesn't exist while the list loads; the detail panel then opens normally.
issues.evidence: URL /invoicing?id=dcc4f347-6215-4d89-b16c-a9b118bf1683 immediately after Return to dashboard; toast text 'Invoice not found' over the skeleton; 2.5s later the panel 'Invoice to Orbital Advisory Partners' with Edit / Remind / More is shown for the same id.

issues.title: Date fields use a smaller input than their neighbors
issues.detail: In the Mark as paid dialog, the Paid on date field uses the compact inline input (32px, 4px corners) directly above a standard 40px, 8px-corner Payment method dropdown of the same width.
issues.evidence: Paid on box: class _inputBox_ _inline_, height 32px, radius 4px, padding 3px 7px, bg rgba(180,183,200,0.08), 720px wide. Payment method: class _input_1ei06_, height 40px, radius 8px 0 0 8px (wrapper 8px), padding 7px 0 7px 12px, 720px wide. Both 15px text.

issues.title: Transaction match shows a bare 'No results' over the buttons
issues.detail: The Transaction match dropdown in Mark as paid opens a column header row and a single left-aligned 'No results' line with no guidance, and the list overlaps the Close / Mark as paid buttons below it.
issues.evidence: Dropdown content: headers 'Paid on', 'Paid by', 'Amount', 'Payment Method'; body 'No results'. The listbox bottom sits over the top of the 'Close' and 'Mark as paid' buttons in the 2x capture (91-mark-paid-transaction-match.png).

issues.title: Due date field blank while the preview shows a date
issues.detail: On Invoice details the Due date field shows no value, yet the live preview already prints a Net 30 due date, so the form and the document disagree until the user picks an option.
issues.evidence: Due date combobox value '' (empty) with menu options 'Sep 24, 2026 Due on receipt', 'Oct 24, 2026 Net 30'…; preview Terms 'Invoice date 09/24/2026, Due date 10/24/2026'.

issues.title: 'View API docs.' link includes the sentence's period
issues.detail: Invoice settings > General, Invoicing API row: the description 'Access the Invoicing API and create automations.' is followed by an inline link whose text is 'View API docs.', period included, so the period is part of the underlined, clickable text.
issues.evidence: DOM (2026-09-25) on /invoicing/invoice-settings: View API docs. inside Access the Invoicing API and create automations. …. Jev p=0.52 that the period belongs outside the link.
